paper.abstract_en: We explore a possible connection between the black hole information paradox and interpolation geometry underlying the double descent phenomenon in quantum machine learning. State-dependent operator reconstruction on the Hawking radiation can be formulated as a quantum linear inverse problem defined on the black hole-radiation purification. In this picture, the Page time corresponds to the interpolation threshold, where the dimensions of the remaining black hole and the radiation become comparable. Using the Marchenko-Pastur law, we study the spectrum of the corresponding Gram matrices and obtain the variance of the linear reconstruction coefficients. The Page point is then related to both a change in the rank structure of the two subsystems and a strong enhancement of the coefficient variance near the interpolation threshold. This suggests a possible relation between the Page transition and interpolation phenomena in quantum machine learning.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将黑洞信息悖论与量子机器学习中的双下降现象联系起来，提出了Page时间与插值阈值之间的对应关系，具有理论深度和跨学科创新性，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞/量子机器学习对应
decision.abstract_zh: 我们探索了黑洞信息悖论与量子机器学习中双下降现象背后的插值几何之间可能存在的联系。霍金辐射上的状态依赖算符重构可以表述为定义在黑洞-辐射纯化上的量子线性反问题。在这一图像中，Page时间对应于插值阈值，此时剩余黑洞与辐射的维度变得相当。利用Marchenko-Pastur定律，我们研究了相应Gram矩阵的谱，并得到了线性重构系数的方差。Page点随后与两个子系统秩结构的变化以及插值阈值附近系数方差的强烈增强都相关。这表明Page转变与量子机器学习中的插值现象之间可能存在关联。
